reasoning: Let a_n be the number of tilings of a 2×n board with 1×2 dominoes and 2×2 squares. Consider the leftmost column: it is covered either by one vertical domino (leaving 2×(n−1)), by two horizontal dominoes stacked (leaving 2×(n−2)), or by a 2×2 square (leaving 2×(n−2)). Hence a_n = a_{n−1} + 2a_{n−2}, with a_0 = 1, a_1 = 1. Computing: a_2=3, a_3=5, a_4=11, a_5=21, a_6=43, a_7=85, a_8=171, a_9=341, a_10=683, a_11=1365, a_12=2731. (Closed form: a_n = (2^{n+1} + (−1)^n)/3, giving (8192+1)/3 = 2731.)
